name: Linebacker Strength Shift vs Motion
formation: 11P Gun Slot Motion Right vs Shifting Flex

summary.motive: Answer offensive formation-strength motion with a synchronized linebacker shift so the defense is never caught flowing cross-eyed into a perimeter run.
summary.keyDefender: The Mike linebacker executing the strength shift
summary.whyItWorks: Most defenses lose leverage when strength flips; Landry’s shift keeps every defender aligned to declared strength, so sweeps meet pre-positioned pursuit instead of reactive flow.
summary.failureMode: A quick snap immediately after the motion catches the shift incomplete, leaving the old strength side soft to an inside zone hit.

beats.title: 1. The Motion That Moves Both Sides
beats.text: The slot receiver carries the motion across the formation, flipping the offensive strength, but the Dallas linebackers begin sliding in perfect sync before the ball is snapped.

beats.title: 2. The Synchronized Shift
beats.text: Mike sprints his shift to stack over the new play-side guard, Sam walks to the apex of the motioned slot, and the safety rotates to the sky half, preserving strength leverage everywhere.

beats.title: 3. Sweeping Into Prepared Strength
beats.text: The offense launches its flank sweep directly into the freshly shifted strength, running straight at defenders who moved there voluntarily.

beats.title: 4. The Strength-Side Swarm
beats.text: The chasing flexed tackle, shifted Mike, and forcing corner converge at the perimeter landmark, holding the sweep to a token gain.

relations.tell: The Mike takes visible sprint steps parallel to the line during the motion rather than shuffling, showing the shift is coached as a sprint-to-landmark rule.
